BookableSlotDto.description:
One dated window the learner can actually book: an open availability row with no live session
inside it yet.

CancelSessionCommand.description:
One call for both sides. The actor decides the lock: the teacher gets 24 h before the start, the
learner 12 h. A learner cancels their own seat; the session itself goes with it only when nobody
is left holding one.

answer.description: Plain text. Newlines are preserved; the front end is responsible for rendering them.

articleCount.description: Number of articles that are still active inside this category.

RequestRescheduleCommand.description:
Proposes a new window for a session. Nothing on the session moves until the other side approves,
so a request is a record, never an edit.

bookings.description: Empty for a learner caller: the roster of who is in the session belongs to the instructor.

myBookingId.description: Populated only for a learner caller, so their own booking state travels with the session.

Bearer.description: Enter the word 'Bearer' followed by a space and your JWT. Example: Bearer <access-token-from-login>
